triggers.name: object_creation_main_location_required
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER object_creation_main_location_required AFTER INSERT ON public.object DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.object_type <> 'ORG'::object_type)) EXECUTE FUNCTION internal.guard_object_main_location_insee()

triggers.name: object_main_location_delete_required
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER object_main_location_delete_required AFTER DELETE ON public.object_location DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.object_id IS NOT NULL) AND (old.is_main_location IS TRUE))) EXECUTE FUNCTION internal.guard_object_main_location_insee()

triggers.name: object_main_location_update_required
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER object_main_location_update_required AFTER UPDATE ON public.object_location DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.object_id IS NOT NULL) AND (old.is_main_location IS TRUE) AND ((new.object_id IS DISTINCT FROM old.object_id) OR (new.is_main_location IS DISTINCT FROM true)))) EXECUTE FUNCTION internal.guard_object_main_location_insee()

triggers.name: object_type_main_location_required
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER object_type_main_location_required AFTER UPDATE ON public.object DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.object_type IS DISTINCT FROM new.object_type) AND (new.object_type <> 'ORG'::object_type))) EXECUTE FUNCTION internal.guard_object_main_location_insee()

concurrency.scenario: Two concurrent transactions: object retype and delete/replace main location, each committing

notes: Three-argument and two-key legacy calls refuse after current authorization checks.
Creation and main location write are atomic; governed assignment failure rolls back object, links, location and history.
Global constraint guards cover direct creation, retyping and main removal without retro-validating legacy rows or institutional ORG.
The committed current-rights integration and concurrency probes execute only on this isolated local copy.
